text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Good work today, Trainer. See you later!
choice_data_list: Okaaay, get plenty of rest now—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I can keep going today, no problem! I've 
still got a whole heap of energy left!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I figured if I train hard enough, I can 
get closer to becoming the true strongest 
miler!
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's train just a little bit 
more.

Still, we've got tomorrow too, so let's 
call it a day here.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you so much, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Just one more push toward the queen's 
throne... No, a 50-mile push! Here I go!

And so, Gran Alegria devoted herself to 
extra training.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see. The road of the mile continues 
tomorrow and the day after, after all!
choice_data_list:
Let's save that energy for tomorrow's 
training.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Understood. That's all for today! I look 
forward to working with you again 
tomorrow♪

And so, Gran Alegria finished her training 
for the day.
